prompt:
Create a faithful generated game asset for Vulcanblubber, exact incarnation Resident Evil Revelations 2 (2015). Use the attached verified references only. Preserve the precise head, anatomy, proportions, costume, equipment, material colours and asymmetric details. Do not mix games, phases or editions. Match the source appearance without added cartoon outlines, coloured halos or decoration. One subject only, no text, labels, scenery, floor, montage or frame. Clean transparent alpha. This remains a generated adaptation, not an original Capcom frame or a geometric 1:1 certificate. One complete full-body static combat idle base pose, facing right in a side/three-quarter fighting-game view. Keep every source-documented limb, foot, tail, wing, tentacle, horn and equipment inside the image with generous transparent padding. Preserve actual locomotion and support points; do not turn a quadruped or aquatic creature into a humanoid. Produce the entire body in this one image, not separate pieces. No motion blur, duplicate bodies or animation-frame grid. Only proceed after actually reviewing a complete source body reference.
The FIRST unmodified full-body source is the real Vulcanblubber despite an old misleading filename. Preserve the caged metal mask/red eye, obese stitched torso and black trim, apron, dark trousers, both boots, mortar on the anatomical RIGHT arm (image-left in the front source), and the raised mace in the anatomical LEFT hand. Keep the entire cannon and mace endpoints within frame. Three-quarter ready stance, face aimed RIGHT, without swapping the weapon arms. Do not copy the source credit watermark as a body marking.
Composition: at least ten percent clear transparent padding around every body, wing, foot, tail and equipment endpoint. One complete boss entry in ONE image, clear rightward presentation; no animation grid, scenery, labels or added coloured halo. Preserve real anatomical asymmetries; no software mirror.
sourceObservation: Both independently opened source and target catalogue show the same caged mask, thick black-trimmed torso, mortar cannon and raised mace. The full source additionally shows the apron, trousers, both boots, complete raised mace and cannon endpoints. Its old filename ironhead is incorrect; this assignment uses visual identity, not the filename.
